description: Rolling green hills and a grassy foreground beneath a clouded pale sky.
composition: Wide layered hills with an open sky and foreground depth.
design_rationale: Use fresh greens, rounded cards and slow transitions to echo the soft hills and open space.

description: A path between purple flowers leads toward a lake and distant peaks under a violet and golden sunset.
composition: Central leading path framed by flowers with a luminous horizon.
design_rationale: Pair violet surfaces with warm gold accents and gentle reveals inspired by the sunset and flower-lined path.

description: Deer stand in a golden meadow below a sunlit granite dome and dark conifers.
composition: Portrait composition with animals low in the frame and a dominant mountain above.
design_rationale: Use warm meadow accents and rounded natural forms with generous vertical spacing.

description: A river winds between dark pine forests and layered blue cliffs under a softly glowing peach sky.
composition: Wide valley with a river leading inward and distant layers fading into haze.
design_rationale: Use muted blue-green layers, flowing dividers and slow motion to reflect the misty river valley.

description: Wooden boats float on clear turquoise water between rocky forested mountains beneath blue sky.
shapes: broad horizontal lake|angular cliffs|small boat ovals
composition: Bright wide scene with small boats anchoring a large area of open water.
design_rationale: Use clear turquoise accents, airy sections and softly rounded controls inspired by the open lake.

description: A rocky river runs through a dark conifer valley with layers of pale fog above the trees.
composition: Central river recedes through dense trees toward a hazy background.
design_rationale: Use deep greens, softened edges and translucent layers to echo forest depth and drifting fog.

description: Bright green hills frame a circular grassy formation and a low golden sun beneath a blue sky.
composition: Centered circular foreground motif with a sunset aligned behind the valley.
design_rationale: Use lively green and golden accents with circular motifs and expansive spacing.

description: Low mist crosses a grassy ridge and winding road while sunlight breaks through clouds.
composition: Sweeping ridge leads from the left foreground toward a distant glowing sky.
design_rationale: Combine muted olive and gray with broad layered sections and restrained warm highlights.

description: A forested mountain valley opens toward distant snowy peaks beneath blue sky and white clouds.
composition: Deep landscape framed by foreground pines and successive mountain layers.
design_rationale: Use cool blue and green accents with structured sections softened by generous spacing.

description: A wooden lakeside cabin sits before still mountain reflections, dark forest and low clouds.
composition: Cabin sits to the lower right while the lake reflects the mountain across the center.
design_rationale: Use muted teal, warm wood accents and calm symmetrical sections with rounded cards.

description: A copper-toned curved facade with repeating diamond-like openings curls around pale sky.
composition: Upward view follows the facade around a large area of sky.
design_rationale: Use copper accents and rhythmic geometric detail while retaining the facade's sweeping curvature.

description: Dark glass skyscrapers converge upward around a pale sky with warm amber windows near the base.
composition: Low-angle view creates strong upward convergence around central negative space.
design_rationale: Use a dark blue grid, crisp corners and brisk reveals to express the towers' vertical energy.

description: Stacked gray balconies and black recesses form strong diagonal bands across a building facade.
composition: Close architectural crop emphasizes repeated diagonals with almost no sky.
design_rationale: Build a compact modular grid with sharp edges and alternating dark and gray bands.

description: A white modular building projects rectangular volumes into a pale blue sky.
composition: Minimal upward composition with open sky surrounding the stepped building.
design_rationale: Use white space, pale blue accents and a clear rectangular grid with minimal ornament.

description: Dark curved facades with dense horizontal rails surround a bright white opening in the sky.
composition: Monochrome upward view uses a bright central opening enclosed by curved buildings.
design_rationale: Use monochrome contrast, rounded containers and repeating fine lines inspired by the enclosing facades.

description: A white rippling lattice facade curves beneath a clear teal-blue sky.
composition: Facade sweeps across the lower frame beneath a broad empty sky.
design_rationale: Combine an airy blue-and-white palette with curved dividers and subtle repeating diamond details.

description: Glass and metal building planes converge around a bright triangular opening overhead.
composition: Near-symmetrical upward perspective centers a triangular patch of sky.
design_rationale: Use triangular accents, crisp geometry and concise movement anchored to a centered grid.

description: A bright white geometric museum with angular projecting volumes stands beside a glass slope.
composition: Wide low-angle composition emphasizes a projecting white volume above diagonal glazing.
design_rationale: Use white modular panels, angular buttons and strong diagonal accents to echo the museum's geometry.

description: Blue-and-white balcony bands curve around a narrow opening of blue sky and warm underside.
composition: Upward crop creates a tall central opening bounded by flowing balcony lines.
design_rationale: Use blue-and-white curved sections with a warm peach accent and smooth transitions.

description: A nighttime skyline has a tall magenta-lit tower and cyan accents against a deep blue sky.
composition: Bright tower cluster rises against a large dark sky with a low dark foreground.
design_rationale: Use a midnight theme with magenta and cyan highlights, sharp cards and restrained pulsing accents.

description: Two golden-brown pears rest on a pale ceramic plate in strong diagonal sunlight and shadow.
composition: Portrait still life with pears clustered above a diagonal light-dark division.
design_rationale: Use warm neutrals, rounded cards and directional shadows inspired by the pears and ceramic plate.

description: Two off-white ceramic vases with thin red berry branches sit beside softly folded fabric in dim light.
composition: Asymmetric pair of vessels with tall branches and a narrow shaft of light.
design_rationale: Pair warm ivory surfaces with small red accents and gently rounded forms in a quiet spacious layout.

description: Blue glass vessels and goblets sit with yellow lemons and oranges on white draped fabric.
composition: Tall grouped still life with repeated blue vessels interleaved with bright fruit.
design_rationale: Use cobalt and citrus accents, rounded components and transparent layering for a bright playful direction.

description: Whole and sliced lemons with green leaves sit on wood in strong soft-edged daylight.
composition: Close horizontal crop with a glowing lemon slice near the center.
design_rationale: Use lemon and leaf accents with rounded controls and warm daylight-like surfaces.

description: A single pink rose in a clear square glass bottle stands against a muted rose wall crossed by sunlight.
composition: Sparse portrait composition leaves generous negative space around one flower.
design_rationale: Use dusty pink, delicate outlines and spacious composition with slow gentle reveals.

description: Cream and golden roses sit in a dark rounded vase on a wooden table against deep green shadows.
composition: Flowers form a compact focal cluster against a large dark background.
design_rationale: Use deep green surfaces, warm gold accents and rounded forms with restrained editorial styling.

description: Three red apples lie beside a blue patterned cloth on a dark mottled surface.
composition: Three apples form a loose triangle within a dark close-cropped still life.
design_rationale: Use deep red accents, tactile surfaces and rounded cards with a grounded compact grouping.

description: A white cup of dark coffee rests on a pale surface cut by a large diagonal black shadow.
composition: Single cup near the lower center balances large geometric areas of light and shadow.
design_rationale: Use a monochrome layout with generous whitespace, circular details and deliberate directional shadows.

description: A mottled green ceramic pitcher stands behind three oranges against a vivid red background.
composition: Central pitcher forms a tall anchor above a horizontal row of fruit.
design_rationale: Pair a warm red backdrop with sage and orange details and rounded tactile components.

description: Sunflowers and green leaves in a ribbed pale vase sit with cut lemons on a weathered wooden chest.
composition: Centered bouquet above a horizontal wooden base with a softly mottled wall behind.
design_rationale: Use warm beige, sunflower accents and rounded cards with subtle texture and relaxed spacing.

description: A red fox sits upright on a dark path, its orange fur lit against a soft gray-green background.
composition: Centered portrait with a bright face against a dark lower frame and blurred background.
design_rationale: Use charcoal surfaces and burnt-orange accents with soft cards and a focused central composition.

description: An antlered deer faces the camera in a dry grassy setting with dark trees and pale sky behind.
composition: Tall portrait centers the face beneath a large branching antler silhouette.
design_rationale: Use warm earth colors and fine branching details within a spacious understated layout.

description: An orange butterfly with black and white wing markings rests on small orange flowers against a warm blurred background.
composition: Close side view places the patterned wing across the frame and flowers to the right.
design_rationale: Use amber accents, rounded controls and small repeated details inspired by the butterfly's patterned wings.

description: A black-and-white puffin with an orange beak and feet stands front-facing on gray rock.
composition: Centered upright bird forms a simple bold silhouette against an out-of-focus background.
design_rationale: Use a clean monochrome foundation, orange highlights and friendly rounded components.

description: A coral-pink flamingo bends its long neck into a loop while preening against turquoise water.
composition: Close portrait fills the frame with a sweeping neck and layered pink feathers.
design_rationale: Use coral and turquoise with sweeping curves and smooth flowing transitions.

description: A white tiger with dark stripes reclines across the ground amid shadowed green foliage.
composition: Reclining animal spans the lower frame against a dense dark leafy background.
design_rationale: Use deep green and ivory with bold linear accents and stable spacious cards.

description: A black-and-yellow toucan with a multicolored beak perches on a mossy branch against blurred green foliage.
composition: Side-on bird sits on a horizontal branch with a large colorful beak pointing left.
design_rationale: Use dark surfaces with controlled yellow, lime and cyan accents and rounded bold components.

description: A golden dog sits on a stone patio holding a yellow flower across its mouth.
composition: Centered seated portrait with soft background separation and a small yellow focal accent.
design_rationale: Use warm cream and gold with rounded cards, friendly spacing and gentle transitions.

description: A wet golden-brown dog runs through white surf toward the camera beneath a pale sunset sky.
composition: Forward-moving centered subject contrasts with broad horizontal sea and sky bands.
design_rationale: Use warm gold against ocean blue with rounded controls and buoyant short motion.

description: A spotted big cat with a pale blue eye fills the frame, looking left against a softly blurred neutral background.
composition: Close portrait crops the animal at the right and emphasizes its eye and patterned coat.
design_rationale: Use warm neutrals and dark surfaces with a precise icy-blue accent and restrained patterned details.

description: Overlapping small pastel tiles form a repeating staggered diamond-like grid across a wall.
composition: Edge-to-edge repeating pattern with varied colors and no single focal subject.
design_rationale: Use muted multicolor accents and a regular modular grid with softly rounded corners.

description: A dark green woven surface shows fine regular fibers, faint pale scuffs and uneven worn patches.
composition: Close edge-to-edge crop has a regular fine weave beneath irregular lighter marks.
design_rationale: Use deep green surfaces, fine tactile texture and softly edged quiet components with restrained contrast.

description: Cream curving lines sweep and fan across a nearly black wall-like surface.
composition: High-contrast cropped pattern fills the frame with alternating dark gaps and light lines.
design_rationale: Use cream outlines on dark surfaces and curved repeating motifs with deliberate spacing.

description: A nearly white plaster surface shows subtle irregular fine grain and very low tonal variation.
composition: Even edge-to-edge texture without a focal point or strong directional structure.
design_rationale: Use warm white backgrounds and very subtle grain with generous spacing and minimal decoration.

description: Frosted glass blurs warm light, pale highlights and cool dark forms into a fine pebbled surface.
shapes: soft color patches|fine pebble pattern|blurred silhouettes
composition: Portrait crop grades from a light upper area into darker cool tones below.
design_rationale: Use translucent frosted surfaces, softly blended colors and rounded layered panels.

description: A gray concrete surface has dense small pits and mottled lighter and darker areas.
composition: Uniform close-up texture with small-scale variation and no focal object.
design_rationale: Use restrained gray surfaces, a crisp grid and slight texture to suggest durable material.

description: A pale woven fabric has fine repeated horizontal and vertical threads with faint gray shading.
composition: Even close-up textile fills the frame with a fine regular structure.
design_rationale: Use soft ivory surfaces and barely visible texture with lightly rounded cards and relaxed spacing.

description: Crumpled cream paper is covered in irregular folds, angular creases and soft warm shadows.
composition: Edge-to-edge paper texture has uneven crease density and shallow dimensional shading.
design_rationale: Use warm paper colors, subtle texture and informal softly shaped components.

description: Dark blue ice contains pale branching fractures and dense feathery crystalline markings.
composition: Close-up fills the frame with an irregular web of bright marks over dark blue.
design_rationale: Use navy and ice-blue highlights with fine branching details and restrained translucent layers.

description: A pale stone surface has cloudy gray veining and irregular softly blended mineral patches.
composition: Even edge-to-edge surface with subtle directional veins and low visual density.
design_rationale: Use pale neutral surfaces, subtle gray detail and spacious elegant layouts.
